kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أرجحن (form IVq)
# أَرْجَحِنُّ (ʔarjaḥinnu) /ʔar.d͡ʒa.ħin.nu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِرْجَحَنَّ (irjaḥanna)
# أَرْجَحِنَّ (ʔarjaḥinna) /ʔar.d͡ʒa.ħin.na/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِرْجَحَنَّ (irjaḥanna)
# أَرْجَحِنِّ (ʔarjaḥinni) /ʔar.d͡ʒa.ħin.ni/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِرْجَحَنَّ (irjaḥanna)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
